method: Actual immutable published 1871 app with only the approved context depth-material patch. Native desktop Full PCF shadow-depth texture sampled at 512x512 texel centers by a small GPU comparison pass, outside the app frame. Same frozen pose/mode is compared with its depth owners temporarily removed (old native fallback), then restored. GPU shaders and live uniforms read immediately after actual caster calls. SwiftShader is software rendering; no hardware FPS/GPU memory claim.
